mappedContracts.statement: Parse frontmatter booleans strictly so false remains false, especially shouldSendEmail.
acceptanceCriteria: shouldSendEmail: false produces boolean false and should_send_email=false.
Invalid boolean-like values block preflight rather than coercing truthy.
Revision and republish default to no email resend.

mappedContracts.statement: Replace synthetic HTTP status 0 and broad status heuristics with discriminated transport outcomes and operation-specific success contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Transport results distinguish response, network-error, cancelled, timeout, and outcome-unknown.
Every operation defines allowed response codes and validates the response schema.
No network failure or redirect can be reported as success.
